commit.message:
fix(reflection): reject known-incomplete proposals without breaking compatibility (#462)

* fix(reflection): reject incomplete fenced proposals safely

* refactor(reflection): use one signature output parser

* refactor(reflection): preserve flexible adapter parsing

* fix(reflection): preserve edge-path behavior

* refactor(reflection): return typed proposal results

+
+    output: dict[str, str] | None
